#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv
lock=$base/.replay.lock

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"
if [ ! -f "$index" ]; then
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index"
fi

exec 9>"$lock"
flock -x 9

quarantine_message()
{
    source_file=$1
    explanation=$2
    name=$(basename -- "$source_file")
    qtmp=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.$name.XXXXXX")
    cp -- "$source_file" "$qtmp"
    chmod 0644 "$qtmp"
    mv -f -- "$qtmp" "$quarantine/$name"

    rtmp=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.$name.reason.XXXXXX")
    printf '%s\n' "$explanation" > "$rtmp"
    chmod 0644 "$rtmp"
    mv -f -- "$rtmp" "$quarantine/$name.reason"
    printf 'quarantined\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$explanation"
}

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    name=$(basename -- "$message")

    header_count=$(awk '
        {
            sub(/\r$/, "")
            if ($0 == "") exit
            colon = index($0, ":")
            if (colon > 0) {
                field = substr($0, 1, colon - 1)
                gsub(/[ \t]/, "", field)
                if (tolower(field) == "message-id") count++
            }
        }
        END { print count + 0 }
    ' "$message")

    if [ "$header_count" -ne 1 ]; then
        quarantine_message "$message" "expected exactly one Message-ID header; found $header_count"
        continue
    fi

    message_id=$(awk '
        {
            sub(/\r$/, "")
            if ($0 == "") exit
            colon = index($0, ":")
            if (colon > 0) {
                field = substr($0, 1, colon - 1)
                gsub(/[ \t]/, "", field)
                if (tolower(field) == "message-id") {
                    value = substr($0, colon + 1)
                    sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", value)
                    sub(/[ \t]+$/, "", value)
                    print value
                    exit
                }
            }
        }
    ' "$message")

    if ! printf '%s\n' "$message_id" | LC_ALL=C grep -Eq '^<[^<>[:space:]]+>$'; then
        quarantine_message "$message" "invalid Message-ID header value"
        continue
    fi

    if awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$message_id" 'NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found=1; exit } END { exit !found }' "$index"; then
        printf 'skipped\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$message_id"
        continue
    fi

    output_name=$name
    if [ -e "$delivered/$output_name" ]; then
        digest=$(printf '%s' "$message_id" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
        output_name=recovered-$digest.eml
    fi

    dtmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.$output_name.XXXXXX")
    cp -- "$message" "$dtmp"
    chmod 0644 "$dtmp"
    mv -f -- "$dtmp" "$delivered/$output_name"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$output_name" >> "$index"
    printf 'delivered\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$message_id" "$output_name"
done
REPLAY_EOF
chmod 0755 "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
mv -f -- "$tmp" "$target"
restorecon "$target" 2>/dev/null || true
sh -n "$target"
stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' "$target"
sha256sum "$target"
sed -n '1,260p' "$target"
